title: Console orientation grid and entry zones redesign
creator: Maya Patel
description: Problem: the current Console navigation mixes global actions, per-project controls, and operational surfaces in ways that make fast orientation and cross-environment routing brittle. Users report: difficulty locating cost and rollout controls, accidental context switches, and long paths to commonly used dashboards. Goal: introduce an 'orientation grid' — a declarative map of console entry zones and activation hotspots — that clarifies where users start tasks (observability, rollouts, cost analysis, model ops) and reduces cognitive switching. Deliver a zone-based routing pattern, updated left-entry rail affordances, and a compact top action band for fast cross-workbench jumps. This ticket covers the exploratory prototypes, design reviews, and a first-pass handoff spec for engineering routing constraints and analytics events.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates 3 distinct entry zones (Observe, Operate, Optimize) with clear destinations for dashboards, rollout controls, and cost views
Left-entry rail includes semantic grouping and a collapsed 'zone selector' state that preserves one-click access to the last-opened project/workbench
Routing spec documents how deep links map into zones and the expected URL shape for preserving zone context across sessions
Usability test (5 users) shows >80% task completion for common tasks: view project cost breakdown, open canary rollout, and navigate back to a tenant overview
Design handoff contains component tokens, interaction timing, and analytics event names for instrumentation
decisions: Adopt a zone-first mental model: Observe (dashboards/alerts), Operate (rollouts/versions), Optimize (cost/quotas)
Left rail becomes a 'zone rail' with persistent micro-state instead of per-project deep links; per-project selectors migrate to the top action band
Keep compact rail collapsed by default for users with wide monitors; persistent expansion controlled by user preference and accessibility setting
Deep link policy: zone context encoded as query param 'zone=observe|operate|optimize' to ensure consistent behavior across sessions and email links
